name: Cat

tensors.description: List of tensors with same shape (except cat dim) and same dtype. Supports float32, float16, bfloat16.

dim.description: int, dimension along which to concatenate.

y.description: Concatenated tensor, same dtype as inputs.

description:
Cat: Concatenates the given sequence of tensors in the given dimension.

torch.cat = cat(tensors, dim=0, *, out=None) -> Tensor

All tensors must either have the same shape (except in the concatenating dimension) or be a 1-D empty tensor with size (0,). torch.cat can be seen as an inverse operation for torch.split and torch.chunk.

Args:
    tensors (sequence of Tensors): Non-empty tensors provided must have the same shape, except in the cat dimension.
    dim (int, optional): the dimension over which the tensors are concatenated.

Keyword args:
    out (Tensor, optional): the output tensor.

Example:
    >>> x = torch.randn(2, 3)
    >>> torch.cat((x, x, x), 0)
    tensor([[ 0.6580, -1.0969, -0.4614],
            [-0.1034, -0.5790,  0.1497],
            [ 0.6580, -1.0969, -0.4614],
            [-0.1034, -0.5790,  0.1497],
            [ 0.6580, -1.0969, -0.4614],
            [-0.1034, -0.5790,  0.1497]])

Returns: Tensor.
